_comment: Rules of skill design-valuation-scenarios. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.reason: low = adverse end of every driver, high = favorable end; directions are stated per driver
rules.gap: no source prescribes a pairing; ranges are not confidence intervals

rules.passage: Relying solely on one scenario may limit the assessment to a single set of outcomes.

rules.reason: weights are the team's; none is invented; no expected value is computed by this skill
owner ruling V5: the adopted valuation, the choice of rate and any fairness or solvency view are human only
